description: 3-stage TOCTOU race condition in checkout stock validation: (1) add checkout endpoint with synchronous stock validation + decrement, (2) add post-checkout processing (receipt generation, email notification — slow ~1s), (3) move stock decrement + processing to background thread for throughput — stock CHECK stays in main thread, DECREMENT moves to background thread. Concurrent checkout requests all pass the stock check, each spawns a background thread that decrements stock, causing overselling (stock goes negative, multiple orders for limited-stock items).
